name: jewelcraft
description: Teaches Claude to model and check jewelry in Blender with the JewelCraft add-on over a Blender MCP connection — prong grip, seat clearance and stone overlaps measured rather than eyeballed, ring sizes read from the band's actual inner surface, metal weight with overlapping parts counted once, and print/cast checks that confirm an STL comes out in millimetres, with the add-on's scripting traps documented and worked around
